_meta.note: Maintenance: WV-area averages originally from RepairPal + AAA Your Driving Costs 2024 (+5% for mountain road conditions), inflated 2026-09-23 for repair-cost growth (BLS CPI motor vehicle maintenance & repair +14% over two years): oil, brakes, misc ×1.15; tires ×1.05 (tire CPI ~flat). Insurance: estimated full-coverage annual premium for a 35-45 year old with a clean record in WV, scaled 2026-09-23 against 2026 WV averages (NerdWallet $2,144, Bankrate $2,162, ValuePenguin $2,148, Insurify $1,862): sedans ×1.15, SUVs/minivans ×1.25, pickups and Jeep Wrangler ×1.08. Actual rates vary widely by driver history, coverage level, and ZIP code. tank_gallons: usable tank capacity for refueling-time calculation. Sept 27 2026: added 44 models so every major brand has at least its top-2 US sellers (2025 sales); their insurance and maintenance were estimated on the same basis, calibrated against comparable vehicles already in this file (see insurance_basis / maintenance_basis on each). Each was independently fact-checked. Sept 27 2026 (fairness review): misc_annual_usd raised ×1.5 to cover scheduled items the old figure left out — engine air and cabin filters, spark plugs, transmission fluid, coolant, serpentine belt, brake fluid, 12V battery (RepairPal Sept 2026 itemization for a RAV4: ~$320–390/yr over 100k mi/8 yrs vs ~$210–230 before). EV misc was raised in lib/calc.ts at the same time. Oil changes now follow miles (every 7,500 mi, min 1/yr) instead of oil_changes_per_year.
